name: Photo Interrupter Sensor
description: Like an invisible tripwire! Infrared beam between two posts detects when an object breaks the beam.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an invisible tripwire! Infrared beam between two posts detects when an object breaks the beam.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and OUT (Green) to digital pin 2.
commonMistakes: Placing transparent objects in the slit that do not sufficiently block infrared light.
Confusing active-HIGH or active-LOW trigger conditions.

miniExperiment.title: Optical Speed Gate
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to Digital Pin 2.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor announces 'Beam Interrupted!' the instant an opaque card or toothpick enters the optical slot.
